Recorded on the fourteenth of March, nineteen twenty eight. Sir Archibald Pemberton, speaking.
Today I have acquired the finest object in any collection on God's green earth. The Golden Duck of Ur-Quack.
The dealer would not take my money. He simply ran. I have never seen a grown man run so fast.
No matter. The Duck shall have the place of honour in the Great Hall. I feel, already, that it is very pleased with me.
